meta.method: Each disclosure read and labelled by a Claude Opus 5.5 agent (8 agents for the first 2,311 disclosures; 2 more for 343 new ones on 2026-10-19). Only uses the developer affirms are labelled; denied uses are ignored.

categories.art: In-game art and visuals (images, textures, sprites, UI art, 3D models, animation, cutscenes, concept art)
categories.marketing: Store page and marketing material (capsule/key art, store text, trailers, promo)
categories.writing: Writing and in-game text (dialogue, story, descriptions, proofreading)
categories.live: Content generated by a generative model during gameplay
categories.other: A named use outside the above (ideation, design help, QA, non-generative models)
categories.unspecified: Says AI was used but not what for

derived.in_game: true when cats includes anything other than marketing or other (i.e. not store-page-only)

meta.text_sha1: first 10 hex chars of SHA-1 of the disclosure text, to detect disclosures that changed since labelling
